notes: the two heads meet at موسى بن على (the ح-branch from وهب and from وكيع), whose tail is shared; «والإخبار في حديث وهب» is an editor's gloss and is left out; «أبي» is the father of Musa (relation); the Companion is عقبة بن عامر; the offsets for the second route are approximate and the shared tail is written once in the text; the matn begins at يوم عرفة
